summary: Pimcore is a multi-channel experience and engagement management platform built on PHP. It functions as a content management system designed to handle digital content and customer data across multiple channels. You can deploy it using Docker to centralise your digital assets and publishing workflows.
goodFor: It suits technical teams that need an open-source PHP framework to manage complex, multi-channel content and digital experiences.
watchOut: The platform requires significant server resources and has a steep learning curve due to its extensive feature set and architectural complexity.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage for user uploads, set up a separate relational database, and use a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
